lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular high-luminance pixel clusters are arranged in approximately four identifiable vertical columns posterior to the branchial slits, transitioning into a staggered grid-like distribution towards the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary blob clusters, forming identifiable grid-like nodes in the region immediately posterior to the fifth branchial slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible above the branchial slits, defined by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with high luminance on the dorsal side and a defined shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, lower-luminance biological entities (remoras) located dorsally above the branchial slits and in a cluster ventral to the mid-flank.
